availability.note: EV Central (Sep 2026): on sale in Australia now, deliveries from September 2026, national pricing; Chasing Cars reports official on-sale 4 September 2026; CarExpert price-and-specs says 'now available in local showrooms'. mercedes-benz.com.au (overview and configurator) returned 403 this run, so no configurator entry was seen directly. Mercedes-Benz Australia sells on a national agency price, so the grade is orderable in Victoria at the same list price.

listPrice.note: CarExpert price table headed 'Price before on-road costs', '$74,990 plus on-roads'; same figure in CarExpert 2027 quick drive, EV Central ('excluding on-road costs'), The Beep ('before on-road costs') and Zecar (MRLP, excludes on-roads). Manufacturer price list unreachable (403). Optional Plus Package $4,000 not included.

batteryKwh.note: usable; EV Database gives 90.0 kWh nominal / 85.0 kWh usable for the same variant; CarExpert 2026 quick drive quotes Mercedes: 85.5 kWh total, 85 kWh usable. Same pack in both grades.

rangeKm.note: WLTP for the AU spec on standard 20-inch AMG Line wheels (CarExpert, Chasing Cars, EV Central agree); 'peak' figures 626/609 km are the best-case wheel. Below EV Database WLTP band (TEL 632 / TEH 538), so passes the direction test.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: CarExpert 2027 quick drive spec table, claimed energy use 17.5 kWh/100km (WLTP rated, includes charging losses; inside EV Database's TEL-TEH band). 85/570x100 = 14.9, 17% off, inside the 25% cross-check.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 145 L with all seven seats up (CarExpert 2027 quick drive; CarExpert 2026 quick drive gives the same 7-seat figure). Seven-seat convention matches kia-ev9 and byd-sealion-8 (all rows up). 480 L with third row folded; 127 L frunk not added. Measurement method not stated; the 565 L in CarExpert's benchmark table conflicts and was ignored.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: 1,605 L with second and third rows folded (CarExpert, EV Central, The Beep). Method not stated: a Mercedes maximum figure is probably to the roof rather than the belt line; no to-the-belt figure found. EV Database's 540/1,715 L are the European five-seat car, which is not sold here (The Beep).

seats.note: Seven seats standard on every grade; five-seat version not offered in Australia. Third row rated for occupants up to 171 cm (Chasing Cars).

towKg.note: EV Database (European data) 1500 kg braked / 750 kg unbraked for this variant. No Australian per-grade figure found: CarExpert's 2027 quick drive gives '1,800-2,000 kg' braked for the whole GLB range without splitting EV grades; Australian price-and-specs articles omit towing. Not from a Mercedes AU spec sheet (403).

warrantyYears.note: Five years, unlimited km; high-voltage battery eight years/160,000 km.

insuranceAnnual.note: anchored to siblings: mercedes-cla-ev-200-eq ($72,200, 1950), mercedes-eqa-250-plus ($86,700, 2250), mercedes-cla-ev-350-4matic-eq ($91,300, 2500). Slightly above the CLA 200 for a larger, heavier seven-seat SUV at $74,990.

depreciationCurve.note: one curve per brand by owner convention: Mercedes-Benz curve as on mercedes-cla-ev and mercedes-eqa. Steeper than mainstream on weak Mercedes EV resale (the GLB EV itself launched more than $15,000 below the outgoing EQB, per CarExpert).
